scope: Phase 4 deterministic drain, recovery and UI validation

drain_contract.terminal_condition: every chunk through the cut sequence is transcript-covered
drain_contract.gap_policy: reject the operation before closing the capture epoch
drain_contract.late_new_chunk_policy: reject after the epoch is stopped; exact duplicate remains idempotent
drain_contract.short_tail_policy: force the remaining bounded VAD window after Pause or End

recovery.browser_queue: concurrent drain callers await the same active upload and exact durable ACK
recovery.page_reload: history exposes an interrupted recording and Recover & pause drains IndexedDB before fixing the backend cut point
recovery.backend_restart: running recognition claims return to durable and the stored operation reaches paused after retry
recovery.recognition_error: source chunks remain durable and last_error plus an SSE event expose the failure

sse.replay: monotonic event id with cursor and Last-Event-ID support
sse.route_test: signed HTTP stream replayed capture.started after the supplied cursor

ui.reload_warning: active capture or queued browser PCM registers beforeunload
